rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3, 19.4 and 19.5 are strong: professional/workmanlike services, conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, a repair/re-perform/replace-then-refund remedy, and a disclaimer that expressly does not swallow express warranties. The failure is duration: Section 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformance warranty to fifteen days after delivery — below the fallback minimum (90 days software / 30 days services) — and its cut-off ("after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation") extinguishes the otherwise open-ended conformance warranty in 19.1 and the remedy in 19.4. Fifteen days is also barely longer than the fifteen-business-day acceptance window in Section 6.1, leaving effectively no post-acceptance warranty coverage. The redline extends the period to ninety (90) days and deletes the cut-off, with a non-limitation cross-reference preserving 19.1/19.3 and the 6.2/19.4 remedies.
